subject.title: [Telegram] 机器人头像更改后无法同步到 Telegram 客户端

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in Telegram bot profile photo sync from the assistant avatar, and if so what source of truth and permission model should own it?
rationale: The code gap is real, but automatically mutating a public Telegram bot profile from local UI state changes user-visible external account state and needs product/security intent before implementation.

options.title: Add opt-in Telegram sync
options.body: Implement a Telegram-plugin-owned, default-off profile-photo sync action or setting using the canonical resolved assistant avatar and focused live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep BotFather manual
options.body: Document that Telegram bot profile photos remain managed in BotFather and do not add OpenClaw-side mutation of bot profile state.

options.title: Manual command only
options.body: Revive a gated manual bot-avatar action without automatic Web UI watching, reducing surprise while avoiding BotFather for advanced users.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in Telegram sync
recommendation.body: Implement a Telegram-plugin-owned, default-off profile-photo sync action or setting using the canonical resolved assistant avatar and focused live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced and recently maintained the current avatar resolution surface that would define the source-of-truth boundary.
